location.site_description: Approximately 795 acres surrounding S. Rowell Road and Bernhard Road, south of the Chicagoland Speedway / Route 66 Raceway area.

status_as_of_cutoff: approved-permitted: Joliet City Council adopted the annexation/development agreement resolution and annexation/zoning/preliminary PUD ordinances on 2026-03-19 by 8-1 votes, but city records still describe future final PUD, final plat, final engineering, right-of-way vacation, and building-permit steps; no construction start, energization, or completion was verified as of 2026-08-11.

actions.result_status: Plan Commission recommended approval of annexation, I-1 zoning upon annexation, preliminary PUD, and preliminary plat for A-4-25/PUD-8-25; minutes record the motion carried 7-1, with Commissioner Kella voting nay and Commissioner Roehr absent.
actions.access_caveat: Plan Commission recommendation only; not final council approval and not a building permit.

actions.government_body: Joliet Plan Commission / City of Joliet
actions.action_type: staff report and public land-use review
actions.result_status: The staff report describes the 795-acre proposal, applicant HW Technology Park Development LLC, annexation A-4-25, and preliminary PUD PUD-8-25. A staff report is not itself final council approval.
actions.access_caveat: Staff report; it does not supply a final roll call or building permit.
actions.evidence_note: Government review record and project scope.

actions.action_type: public hearing / agenda for annexation, zoning, preliminary PUD and plat
actions.result_status: The official notice scheduled a public hearing and listed A-4-25 and PUD-8-25 actions. The notice establishes the agenda, not the final vote result.
actions.access_caveat: Agenda/notice is not substituted for certified minutes; no tally inferred.

actions.government_body: Joliet City Council / City of Joliet
actions.result_status: City Council adopted the annexation agreement resolution for approximately 795 acres surrounding S. Rowell Road and Bernhard Road. Official minutes identify the resolution as Resolution 8262 and show the motion carried with eight ayes and Councilwoman Suzanna Ibarra voting nay.
actions.access_caveat: Conditional annexation/development-agreement approval only; not a building permit, construction start, or energization record.

actions.result_status: City Council adopted ordinances approving annexation, I-1 zoning upon annexation, preliminary PUD, and preliminary plat for Joliet Technology Center. Official minutes identify Ordinances 18826 and 18827 and show the motion carried with eight ayes and Councilwoman Suzanna Ibarra voting nay.
actions.access_caveat: Local land-use entitlement only. City memo and ordinance require future final approvals and permits before construction.
actions.evidence_note: Official final City Council minutes; ordinance text available at https://joliet.legistar.com/View.ashx?GUID=291D54D7-EBC9-44A4-9C86-042385770394&ID=15317193&M=F and https://www.joliet.gov/home/showpublisheddocument/36856/639089066745700000.

actions.government_body: Joliet City Council / Community Development Department
actions.action_type: project scope and utility conditions in council memo
actions.result_status: Council memo states the petitioner intends four future phases, each with one six-building cluster, totaling 24 principal data center buildings and about 6,936,000 gross square feet; electrical substations of about 6 acres would accompany each phase and a larger 25-acre switching station would be on the west side. The memo states future final PUD petitions and final plats are required for each phase.
actions.access_caveat: Scope and conditions in council memo; not evidence that any phase has final PUD, building permits, construction, or energization.
actions.evidence_note: Official City Council memo attached to passed item 179-26.

actions.government_body: Joliet City Council / Community Development Department
actions.result_status: Council memo records the developer estimate of 1,800 MW at full buildout, says ComEd identified and planned transmission/system upgrades, and states PJM and ComEd evaluated full-buildout reliability. The memo also caps average daily potable water use at 150,000 gallons and average daily sanitary sewer discharge at 50,000 gallons, with peak daily limits of 300,000 gallons.
actions.access_caveat: Power figure is a developer estimate recited in a city memo; no energized load or interconnection completion inferred.
actions.evidence_note: Official City Council memo attached to passed item 179-26.

owner: PowerHouse Hillwood Holding LLC is the applicant/contract purchaser; city/project materials identify Hillwood and PowerHouse Data Centers as development partners. Current land owners remained Bernhard Farms Inc. and related Bernhard family owners in the 2026-03-05 staff report.

contradictions.description: Some third-party trackers describe the project as planned, permit-approved, or approved/under construction. Official Joliet records verify local annexation/zoning/preliminary PUD approvals, but continue to require future final PUD/plats/engineering and do not verify building permits, construction start, energization, or completion.

history.previous_value: City records establish conditional annexation, I-1 zoning, preliminary PUD/plat, and an annexation/development agreement; no building permit, construction start, energization, or completion was located.
